a: &&/||/! for and/or/not.chunk:
fn chunk(xs: List[Int], n: Int) -> List[List[Int]]
  requires: n >= 1
{
  return xs
    |> enumerate()
    |> group_by(|p| p.0 / n)
    |> map(|g| map(g.1, |p| p.1))
}
